sheet.div: This action imports demo data for all forms: 3 customers, 3 work sites, 6 employees, 3 interview rating forms, 4 appointment orders, 2 start-of-work forms, guarantees and pledges, 2 transfers, 3 penalties and 2 termination orders. All records are in draft state. It also creates 10 demo internal users with different roles (HR manager, officer, operations manager, site supervisor, logistics, AA administration, MD vehicles, finance, managing director, and a user without permissions) with the password Demo@2026, and restricts the termination form to the HR manager and the managing director to test permissions. Delete the demo data before real use. The import can be repeated without duplicating records.
